recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if OO/II decide to add a formal mapping table or profile for a narrower DICOM-image use case; adding more core prose now would go beyond the accepted modified resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-41613 asked for guidance on filling out DocumentReference for DICOM-derived images, including rendered/non-rendered content, WADO access, DICOM identifiers, and possible ImagingStudy or ImagingSelection context. Its Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution narrowed this to resource-editor guidance in Notes plus Boundary/Relationship text.
initial_application: The DICOM Boundary/Relationship paragraph was introduced earlier by FHIR-38950. FHIR-41613 was then applied through HL7/fhir PR #3020, which listed FHIR-41613 and changed DocumentReference introduction and notes; commit 97cf6bb0ede5497d006a53d90f53c1cc2b41248f added ImagingSelection to the DICOM boundary paragraph and added the current Notes bullet for rendered DICOM images.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread led directly to FHIR-41613 and framed DocumentReference as useful for limited DICOM-image cases after Media was merged into DocumentReference, while ImagingStudy and ImagingSelection remain the richer imaging resources. OO WGM minutes confirm the modified disposition, and current ImagingStudy/ImagingSelection boundary text points back to DocumentReference only for rendered or limited-context DICOM images.
reconciliation: No source change was made. DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source already includes DICOM/WADO boundary guidance, a Notes bullet tying rendered DICOM images to ImagingStudy or ImagingSelection, and a DICOM example with study/series/instance identifiers and a WADO URL.
